name: Bénéteau S.A.
summary: Bénéteau S.A. designs, produce, and sells recreational boats in France, rest of Europe, North America, South America, Asia, and internationally. It provides boats under the Beneteau, Jeanneau, Lagoon, Prestige, Four Winns, Scarab, WellCraft, EXCESS, and Delphia brand names. The company also offers Band of Boats, a community services platform for purchase and sale of boats; lease purchase, credit, insurance services, and inventory and retail finance solutions through SGB Finance; Dream Yacht Charter, offers a large fleet of boats, and a yacht brokerage consultant; Your Boat Club, an online booking system; and WIZIBOAT, a mobile app offers subscription for sailing.
